# gitmoap_group_members (Data Source)

List group members. The people with a direct role on the group, newest first, at most 100 per page; `search` narrows them by username or email. A group's roster is not public, even when the group is: the caller must be signed in and able to see who has access here (Reporters and above with the built-in roles).

The token needs `group_member:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_members" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Optional

- `search` (String) Autocomplete fragment — substring match on the member's username or email
